    boundary = n['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)

    color_positions[c].append((center_r, center_c, n['pixels']))

print("Color summary:")
for c, positions in sorted(color_positions.items()):
    print(f"  {c}: {len(positions)} objects, centers: {positions[:5]}...")

# Let me identify the cell grid structure by looking at gray block positions

    min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
